cards.title: The counter has unwritten rules
cards.body: Busy shop, five people talking at once, one person behind the counter. A little etiquette makes it faster and safer for everyone.

cards.title: Have the prescription ready
cards.body: Not buried in WhatsApp under a pile of good morning forwards. Keep it in hand or pinned.

cards.title: Wait your turn, mostly
cards.body: Emergencies aside, jumping the queue just means two orders get mixed up.

cards.title: Give privacy, get privacy
cards.body: Step back a little when someone else is asking something personal. You'd want the same.

cards.title: Don't rush the double-check
cards.body: If the chemist re-reads the prescription or checks the strip again, let them. That's the safety part.

cards.title: Check before you leave
cards.body: Medicine name, strength, quantity and expiry. Much easier to fix at the counter than after you're home.

cards.title: Say thank you
cards.body: They handle a lot of pressure quietly. A little warmth at the counter goes a long way.

takeaway: Have the prescription ready, respect the queue and privacy, let the chemist double-check, and check your medicines before leaving.
share: Send this to the uncle who reaches over the counter to point at strips.
